thread:
anya: Proposal — embed a compact heatmap into the p95 card header and move sampling control down into the scrubber as a micro-handle. saves vertical space and groups time controls.
sam: interesting. How will users discover presets?
matt: mocked 3 variants: inline micro-heatmap + inline handle; stacked mini-heatmap above scrubber with visible presets; a hybrid where presets float above when handle focused. figma: https://figma.com/s/scrubber-variants
anya: hybrid seems promising. keep inline for default, show presets on focus or hover.
leo: accessibility note: the mini handle must meet 44px touch target & `:focus-visible` outline. Also ensure focus order doesn't skip the scrubber.
aria: color/accessibility: at small size our palette fails contrast. suggest darker midtones and a 2px outline on hover/selected bucket.
katie: copy: label 'Sampling rate' + subtitle 'Shows a subset of requests to reduce visual noise'. shorter alt: 'Show subset of requests'.
sam: UX: show transient numeric tooltip while dragging (e.g., `5%`). Also consider a small confirmation toast when switching presets so it's obvious.
matt: dev notes: add `mini-heatmap` variant, tokens for focus & stroke, aria-live region for SR updates. aria message example: `Sampling set to five percent` (avoid raw numbers during fine-grain nudges).
leo: keyboard spec: tab to sampler, left/right = 1% nudge, shift+arrow = 5% nudge, ctrl+arrow = jump to presets, home/end to min/max. SR should announce only when value crosses preset thresholds or on release.
aria: voiceover/readers: avoid exposing every bucket as a separate tab stop. implement a listbox pattern: single summary control reads "heatmap: 6 buckets, use arrow to cycle" then arrow keys cycle buckets and read counts.
anya: for sighted users, hovering a bucket shows count tooltip. compact mode hides labels and shows only color stripes.
katie: microcopy tweak: change subtitle to 'Reduce chart noise to emphasize latency patterns.'
sam: presets proposal: 0.5%, 5%, 100% — fast toggles for ultra-sparse, representative, and full. plus custom drag.
matt: handoff checklist: updated figma links, CSS focus token, 44px hit area, color variables, keyboard spec doc, aria-live messaging, and unit tests for focus behavior.
anya: next steps: matt updates figma + dev notes; leo/aria run keyboard + SR smoke tests on prototype; katie finalizes copy.
deploy-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/scrubber-heatmap-preview (expires in 48h)
anya: great — once preview is up we'll run a 5-min lab with 3 folks. thanks all :thumbsup:
